run_translation_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI to translate pre-processed data with a trained model
run_main_with_args: run the main function with parsed args to generate translations and output results to a file
run_cli_main: run the cli_main entry point to parse arguments and start generation with a trained model
review_main_function: review the main function that validates args, opens output, and delegates to the internal generation loop
review_internal_generation_loop: review the _main function that loads models, iterates batches, runs inference, and scores hypotheses
